Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck on the driver side while turning
left. The patient reports bracing with an outstretched hand at impact and presented with pain, swelling, and limited
motion of the right wrist. Radiographs confirmed a distal radius fracture, and examination findings were consistent
with the imaging. The mechanism of injury and the force described are in keeping with this type of fracture. No prior
injury or treatment to the same area is known to this provider. Care was provided across there visits, consisting of
immobilization, pain management, and follow-up imaging, with a typical recovery course. Symptoms and range of
motion improved steadily, and treatment was tapered as the patient progressed. Billing records for this episode are
currently under routine review for duplicate entries.
